summary: Created opsbot on both nodes, configured node1’s Ed25519 key for node2 access, and enforced public-key-only SSH authentication for opsbot. Configuration and access survived sequential reboots of both nodes. Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts were retained.
actions_performed: Created opsbot accounts with node-local random password hashes.
Generated an Ed25519 key as opsbot on node1 and authorized it on node2.
Applied opsbot-scoped SSH policies disabling password and keyboard-interactive authentication.
Verified commands execute remotely as opsbot and non-key authentication is rejected.
Rebooted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: opsbot key-based access from node1 to node2
evidence.summary: Matching key fingerprints were installed, and node1 executed commands on node2 as uid 1001 opsbot before and after reboots.

evidence.requirement: Key-only authentication for opsbot on both systems
evidence.summary: Both effective sshd policies require publickey and disable password/keyboard-interactive authentication; a non-key attempt was rejected.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on Alpine 3.23.3 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 9eff3fed-a562-4026-928e-7df1602f009e to ab19adb0-0f02-4fa4-b4fe-7d97ad6bc19f; sshd, account, key, policy, and remote access recovered.
